kicker: Guidance raised on consecutive calls · Q1 and Q2 FY27
title: Three calls, three raises: guides keep climbing
dek: Six companies raised the same FY27 guide on both the Q1 and Q2 FY27 calls: HFCL from 20–25% revenue growth to at least 80%, Carborundum's ceramics from 15% to 25–28%, ACME's battery target from 10 GWh to 12 GWh-plus.

stats.note: From 20–25% in May; Q2 revenue rose 143.6%.

read: A second raise in a row says the first was not a one-quarter beat; the test now is whether Q3 holds the higher bar.
sources: Vantage analysis of Q4 FY26, Q1 FY27 and Q2 FY27 earnings calls; Q2 FY27 results filed on BSE
notes: Companies whose Q1 FY27 and Q2 FY27 calls were both flagged as raising guidance, and where the call summaries confirm the same measure went up twice; starting points are from the Q4 FY26 calls in May 2026. HFCL: FY27 revenue growth 20–25% (May, called conservative and not formal), 40% and above (29 Jul), at least 80% (26 Oct). ACME Solar: battery storage commissioning of 10 GWh by calendar 2027, then more than 10 GWh by FY27, then more than 12 GWh in FY27. Carborundum: consolidated ceramics sales growth 15–15.5%, 23–25%, 25–28%. Radico: Prestige & Above volume growth 20%, over 25%, 30%. Dr Lal PathLabs: revenue growth early-to-mid teens (13–15%), towards mid-teens, high teens. Neogen: standalone (base business) FY27 revenue ₹875–950 cr, ₹950–1,050 cr, about ₹1,100 cr-plus. Raising a guide is not the same as meeting it.
